documentation.content: A hireloom-crawler Cloud Run Job execution failed (after its retry). Logs: Cloud Run > Jobs > hireloom-crawler > Executions. A run skipped because another held the lock exits 0 and does not fire this.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name = "hireloom-crawler" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result = "failed"
